title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on Special Disposal of Veterans Relief Property
full_text:
Enforcement Decree of the Act on Special Disposal of Veterans Relief Property

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters necessary for the enforcement of the Act on Special Disposal of Veterans Relief Property (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").

Article 2 (Determination of Veterans Relief Property)
(1) In donating veterans relief property, the lot numbers or areas in pyeong shall be determined by the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration in consultation with the Minister of Finance and Economy. <Amended on December 23, 1994>
(2) The Minister of Finance and Economy shall transfer the veterans relief property determined pursuant to paragraph (1) to the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration. <Amended on December 31, 1974; December 23, 1994>

Article 3 (Applications for Donation)
Where persons eligible for veterans relief under Article 2 (1) of the Act who have been granted permission to use or derive profit from veterans relief property according to the group classifications prescribed in the Annex under Article 2 (2) of the Act wish to receive such property by donation in co-ownership, they shall submit, in the joint names of all such persons, an application for donation of veterans relief property in attached Form No. 1-1 (attached Form No. 1-3 in the case of a corporation) to the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration, accompanied by the following documents; where they wish to receive the property by donation after partition pursuant to the proviso of Article 5, they shall submit an application in attached Form No. 1-2, accompanied by the following documents: <Amended on December 31, 1974>
1. A statement of the circumstances under which permission to use or derive profit from the veterans relief property was granted;
2. A statement of debts relating to the veterans relief property;
3. A resident registration record and a certificate of registered seal impression (in the case of a corporation, a certified copy of its corporate register and a certificate of the registered seal impression of its representative);
4. A drawing of the veterans relief property;
5. Other reference documents.

Article 4 (Issuance of Deeds of Donation)
Upon receiving an application for donation of veterans relief property under Article 3, the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration shall examine it, decide on the donation of the relevant veterans relief property, issue to the applicant a deed of donation of veterans relief property in attached Form No. 2, and notify the Minister of Finance and Economy thereof without delay. <Amended on December 31, 1974; December 23, 1994>

Article 5 (Method of Donation)
Veterans relief property shall be donated in co-ownership to persons eligible for veterans relief under Article 2 (1) of the Act who have been granted permission to use or derive profit from it: Provided, That where the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration deems that donation in co-ownership would prevent achievement of the purpose of donating the relevant veterans relief property, the Administrator may donate it after partition.

Article 6 Deleted <December 30, 1983>

Article 7 Deleted <December 30, 1983>

Article 8 Deleted <December 30, 1983>

Article 9 Deleted <December 30, 1983>

Article 10 Deleted <December 30, 1983>

Article 11 Deleted <December 30, 1983>

Article 12 (Demand for Reporting Claims)
(1) When the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration intends to donate veterans relief property, the Administrator shall, by public notice on at least three occasions, demand that creditors holding claims against the relevant veterans relief property report their claims within 30 days.
(2) The public notice under paragraph (1) shall state that creditors who fail to report their claims within the period will be excluded from repayment of claims. <Amended on December 31, 1974>
(3) When the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration receives a report of a claim under paragraph (1), the Administrator shall notify the person designated to receive the relevant veterans relief property by donation to repay the debt. When repayment of the debt is completed, the creditor and the debtor shall submit a confirmation of repayment of the debt in their joint names to the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration.
(4) Where two or more persons have reported claims against veterans relief property and it is deemed impossible to identify the rightful creditor for repayment of the debt, the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration may require the debtor to deposit an amount equivalent to the debt to be repaid and donate the relevant veterans relief property.

Article 13 (Approval for Sale, etc.)
(1) Where a person who has received veterans relief property by donation intends to sell or transfer the property or provide it as security, or a person seeking to attach donated veterans relief property intends to effect the attachment, pursuant to the proviso to Article 6 of the Act, that person shall submit to the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration an application for approval of sale, transfer, provision as security, or attachment in attached Form No. 3, together with the following documents:
1. Description and inventory of the property.
2. Certified copy of the property register.
3. Co-owners' written consent to partition.
4. Statement of reasons for the application.
(2) Upon receiving an application under paragraph (1), the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration shall examine it and issue to the applicant written approval for sale, transfer, provision as security, or attachment in attached Form No. 4. <Amended on December 31, 1974>

Article 14 (Registration)
(1) A person who has received veterans relief property by donation shall, upon receiving a deed of donation of veterans relief property under Article 4, submit an application for registration of the relevant veterans relief property to the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration.
(2) Upon receiving an application for registration under paragraph (1), the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration shall, without delay, submit to the registry office a written request for registration of transfer of ownership, with the deed of donation of veterans relief property attached. <Amended on December 31, 1974>
(3) The written request under paragraph (2) shall specify the prohibitions provided for in Article 7(2) of the Act. <Amended on December 31, 1974>

Article 15 (Same as Above)
(1) When registration under Article 14 is completed, the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration shall deliver the certificate of completion of registration issued by the head of the relevant registry office to the person designated to receive the veterans relief property by donation. <Amended on December 31, 1974>
(2) Upon receiving the certificate of completion of registration under paragraph (1), the person designated to receive veterans relief property by donation shall, without delay, submit a certified copy of the register to the Administrator of the Veterans Relief Administration. <Amended on December 31, 1974>

Article 16 (Same as Above)
When a person who has received veterans relief property by donation intends to sell or transfer the property or provide it as security, or a person seeking to attach donated veterans relief property intends to effect the attachment, that person shall attach to the application for registration the written approval for sale, transfer, provision as security, or attachment under Article 13(2).

Article 17 (Use Fees)
The rent under Article 8 of the Act shall include fees for use of the relevant veterans relief property.

ADDENDA <No. 5031, June 12, 1970>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <No. 7490, December 31, 1974>

ADDENDA (Decree Repealing the Regulations on the Industrial Rationalization Deliberation Council, etc. and Partially Amending the Enforcement Decree of the Commodity Management Act, etc. to Reorganize Committees) <No. 11304, December 30, 1983>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 14438, December 23, 1994>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (120) Omitted.

(121) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Special Disposal of Veterans Relief Property shall be amended as follows:

In Article 2, paragraphs (1) and (1), and in Article 4, "Minister of Finance" shall be replaced with "Minister of Finance and Economy".

(122) through (327) Omitted.
